finding_C01_id: raw-fd-production-is-not-exception-total-before-record-ownership
finding_C01_fact_1: actor and watchdog acquisition helpers can receive or store a raw fd, then raise before the owns bit becomes true; exception cleanup consults only the false owns bit and loses the live raw number
finding_C01_fact_2: pipe2 and socketpair return two descriptors but failure after first adoption can leave the second solely in a transient tuple or wrapper; clone3 writes a pidfd before the record is marked ACQUIRING and multiple branches precede adoption
finding_C01_required_design: every producer uses an explicit raw-local fallback protected by try/finally in addition to its preallocated record; the record is marked ACQUIRING before the call, each returned number is stored immediately, and any number not yet authoritatively owned is strict-close/reconciled from the raw fallback regardless of owns-bit state; two-ended and clone3 producers cover every returned cell independently
finding_C02_id: SCM-rights-quarantine-is-neither-first-post-recvmsg-nor-semantically-deferred
finding_C02_fact_1: all five recvmsg paths first expose installed rights in transient ancillary/array containers; exceptions during decoding or before quarantine can lose current and later rights, and external receipt performs a fallible checkpoint before quarantine
finding_C02_fact_2: recv_monitored promotes quarantine records to OUT_FD, OUTER_PIDFD, STAGE_DIRFD or CGROUP_DIRFD before packet framing and semantic validation, giving malformed or false packets authoritative semantic provenance
finding_C02_required_design_1: first post-recvmsg action enters an exception-total bounded quarantine scope that retains the raw ancillary result and resolves every installed right even if decoding, iteration or adoption fails; no checkpoint, framing, allocation, array conversion or semantic work precedes capture
finding_C02_required_design_2: rights remain nonsemantic quarantine records through complete packet parse, deadline, count/order, identity, type, access, inode, cgroup and stream validation; only the fully validated branch performs one in-place semantic promotion, while every reject or exception reconciles all quarantine records without semantic labels
finding_C03_id: promotion-proved-close-poller-and-completion-transitions-are-not-atomic-or-repairable
finding_C03_fact_1: actor/watchdog promotion exposes destination and source as simultaneous live owners across a poller/dictionary update window; failure leaves duplicate owners with no repair path and neither helper revalidates identity plus global uniqueness immediately before handoff
finding_C03_fact_2: poller cells and close-completion flags can be split by exceptions, producing active pollers with missing objects or monotone-closed true while completion remains false and future calls return early
finding_C03_required_design: keep one authoritative preallocated record and change its semantic role in place only after same-number identity and global-owner revalidation; pollers reference record identity rather than slot names; no allocation, dictionary insertion, journal append or poller walk occurs inside handoff; proved-close and closure-complete each use one authoritative retry-repairable monotone state before optional metadata cleanup
finding_C04_id: offer-exhaustiveness-and-unique-kill-proof-ignore-live-quarantine-or-unknown-access
finding_C04_fact: registry-derived offer selects only transferable-labeled records; 34 quarantine records are nontransferable, so a retained live right can be omitted; unique_kill_authority counts declared ROOT_KILL_FD labels rather than scanning every live registered fd by bound leaf identity and writable access, allowing hidden same-leaf writable authority
finding_C04_required_design_1: before freeze, send and acceptance, every live registry record is either exactly included in the canonical offer or belongs to a fixed proved-safe local-only allowlist; any live quarantine, receive, observation or unknown-access record blocks offer until closed or validated/promoted
finding_C04_required_design_2: unique kill scans the exhaustive live registry by cgroup leaf identity plus writable access mode, not labels; any unknown access/identity blocks; sender and receiver acceptance bind the exhaustive installed-right set and prove exactly one writable kill identity at ARM, kill, freeze, pre-send and commit
finding_C05_id: closure-cursor-and-endpoint-detach-are-not-exception-total
finding_C05_fact_1: one OwnershipClosePending return from transfer_or_hold can let main finally exit while ownership_close_started remains true and local descriptors remain outside the authoritative cursor completion
finding_C05_fact_2: endpoint detach can succeed then raise before context clear; retry detaches an already detached wrapper and strands the cursor; owner_poll still interprets raw POLLNVAL mask as actor loss
finding_C05_fact_3: after owner_released, finally calls close_probe whose containment-bound unique-kill invariant still demands one live ROOT_KILL_FD even though exhaustive closure correctly left zero, producing deterministic exit 96 after logical release
finding_C05_required_design_1: once ownership_close_started is true, main/finally remains in the same no-deadline monotone cursor loop until exhaustive proved closure sets owner_released; no pending return may reach process exit and no new offer or state downgrade is possible
finding_C05_required_design_2: endpoint detach has a monotone DETACHED state retaining the raw fd and wrapper state; retry accepts fileno minus one and continues the recorded raw close; every pidfd mask uses pidfd_ready_event, POLLNVAL is fault, and closed pidfds are removed from pollers
finding_C05_required_design_3: close_probe is idempotent after ownership closure and post-release unique-kill cardinality is zero; collapse closure-complete flags into one repairable authoritative state
finding_C06_id: late-outer-pidfd-readiness-promotion-conflicts-with-mandatory-registry-assertion
finding_C06_fact: acceptance promotes PRE_READY state to POST_OFFER_READY_LOCAL_RETAINED_UNTIL_ACCEPTED_CLOSE, then assert_registry_transfer_set recomputes external_identity which accepts only PRE_READY; the advertised late-readiness path deterministically fails before COMMITTED
finding_C06_required_design: capability byte identity freezes at offer installation and remains valid for both authenticated PRE_READY and later POST_OFFER_READY retained state; registry assertions compare the frozen capability identity plus same live fd number/identity and do not require mutable readiness state to revert; acceptance closes/omits by the authenticated late state without changing offer bytes
finding_C07_id: drain-immediate-EOF-EAGAIN-and-overflow-state-are-invalid
finding_C07_fact: drain references chunk or room after a first BlockingIOError or immediate EOF, leaving them unbound; an earlier overflow can be lost when final EOF replaces chunk with empty bytes
finding_C07_required_design: calculate room and accumulate overflow inside each successful nonempty-read iteration before truncation/extension; EAGAIN and EOF break without any post-loop chunk or room read, and overflow is monotone OR
finding_M01_id: socket-wrapper-construction-and-binding-have-an-unprotected-ownership-gap
finding_M01_fact: actor/watchdog construct socket wrappers and bind them before entering protected cleanup; constructor or bind failure can let a destructor close a registry-owned fd or leave wrapper ownership untracked
finding_M01_required_design: constructor plus immediate record binding occurs inside one exception-total endpoint-adoption primitive with a local wrapper fallback; every failure either stores the wrapper into the already-owning record or detaches it and lifecycle-reconciles the exact raw number; destructor is never the ownership mechanism

V16_design_A01_record_model: one authoritative preallocated physical record uses CLOSED, ACQUIRING, OWNED and CLOSE_RETRY states with immutable record_id/provenance plus mutable semantic_role, raw_fd, identity/access and endpoint state; there is no independent owns bit, and every ACQUIRING record containing an fd counts as live
V16_design_A02_raw_fallback: each producer has a preallocated raw cell in EMPTY, LOCAL_RAW, SHADOW_OF_RECORD or DISARMED state; a protected try/finally begins before the producing call, stores every returned number immediately and strict-close/reconciles each LOCAL_RAW fallback regardless of record state or later exception
V16_design_A03_preallocation: preallocate every physical record, single and pair raw cell, clone3 pidfd cell, five receive intake frames with quarantine and overflow records, poller cell, close plan/cursor and bounded journal cell; acquisition, quarantine, promotion and close handoff perform no allocation or dictionary, list, tuple, journal or poller-object construction
V16_design_A04_producer_census: actor producers are actor_acquire_open, dup, F_DUPFD_CLOEXEC, dup2, memfd, pipe2, socketpair, pidfd_open and clone3 pidfd; watchdog producers are open, memfd and dup; inherited and received descriptors use the same adoption discipline; pair and clone3 outputs are independently covered before any validation
V16_design_A05_C_boundary: pipe2 and socketpair use preallocated C integer output cells, clone3 marks its physical record ACQUIRING before the syscall and immediately adopts the pidfd output cell, and receive paths use a preallocated libc msghdr/control-buffer boundary where a Python allocating result cannot prove first-action capture
V16_design_A06_small_fd_scalar: lower RLIMIT_NOFILE to 256, prove the complete live high-water mark remains below 256 and constrain all returned fd targets to 0 through 255 so the frozen CPython cached-small-int behavior is explicitly bound as a subpredicate of CLONE3_CPYTHON; no seventh named external gate is introduced
V16_design_A07_receive_frames: actor recv_control, watchdog recv_monitored, external control, external receipt and refusal receive sites reserve respectively four, four, thirteen, thirteen and four semantic rights plus one overflow quarantine, with ancillary capacity at least cap-plus-one times CMSG_SPACE(sizeof(int)), MSG_CMSG_CLOEXEC and truncation rejection only after every visible right is quarantined
V16_design_A08_receive_first_action: the first post-recvmsg action records every kernel-installed right in its fixed nonsemantic quarantine or raw fallback; no packet parse, deadline, checkpoint, allocation, ancillary conversion, iteration or semantic assertion precedes that capture, and every rejection, truncation or exception resolves every installed right
V16_design_A09_deferred_semantics: rights remain nonsemantic through complete framing, deadline, count/order, identity, type, access, inode, cgroup and stream validation; recv_monitored promotes only fully validated stream_arm rights to OUT_FD/ERR_FD/EVENTS_FD, pidfd_arm to OUTER_PIDFD, stage_bind to STAGE_DIRFD and containment_bind to CGROUP_DIRFD; external receipt quarantines before its first checkpoint and carrier temporaries close without promotion
V16_design_A10_atomic_promotion: promotion revalidates exact identity, access and global ownership, then assigns one semantic_role in place on the same physical record; pollers refer to record_id, no destination record becomes live, and no fallible allocation, journal operation or poller walk occurs in the handoff
V16_design_A11_close_transition: close enters CLOSE_RETRY before fallible work, revalidates identity, reconciles pollers and wrappers and reaches CLOSED as the sole proof of physical release; aggregate closure state is one NOT_STARTED, CLOSING or CLOSED_COMPLETE enum rather than split completion flags
V16_design_A12_wrapper_adoption: wrapper construction and binding begin inside the protected primitive with a local wrapper fallback and immediate strong reference in the already-owning record; every failure detaches/reconciles the exact raw descriptor and destructor behavior is never treated as ownership or close proof
V16_design_B01_offer_partition: assuming the frozen 97-record watchdog domain, exactly thirteen offered permanent slots are attempt, attempt_base, stage, cgfd, root_events, root_kill, out, err, events, outer_pidfd, cgroup_base, actor_control and pending_expected_raw; exactly twelve fixed safe-local-only slots are the transfer endpoint, actor pidfd, external-owner pidfd and nine carriers; all remaining seventy-two transient, acquisition, receive, quarantine, unknown or close-retry slots block an offer
V16_design_B02_refusal_special_case: refusal is separately guarded on the actor-control path and its offered rights set is exactly empty; it does not weaken or extend the 13/12/72 generic partition
V16_design_B03_exhaustive_offer_proof: freeze, pre-send and acceptance compare the full live census with the canonical offered and safe-local sets; any ACQUIRING record, LOCAL_RAW fallback, live quarantine, unknown identity/access or CLOSE_RETRY blocks; receiver receipt binds complete installed history, full-live and kill censuses including a received-then-closed outer pidfd
V16_design_B04_unique_kill: scan every live physical record by bound leaf identity and actual writable access rather than semantic label; unknown identity/access blocks, and the required writable-kill cardinality is proved at ARM, kill, freeze, pre-send and acceptance while post-release cardinality is exactly zero
V16_design_B05_closure_cell: replace split closure flags with one preallocated ClosureCell whose phase is NOT_STARTED, ACTIVE, CLOSED or RELEASED, mode is GENERIC_ACCEPTED, REFUSAL_ACCEPTED or DIRECT, and immutable plan, cursor, current record and retry timing identify the sole resumable transition
V16_design_B06_no_return_close: once ACTIVE, no checkpoint, deadline, offer construction, resend, receive, process return or state downgrade is reachable; a no-return driver resumes the same cursor until RELEASED, retrying persistent close errors with a bounded positive 10-to-50-ms wait under the existing external-survival premises, while safety continues even if a timely tail cannot be certified
V16_design_B07_endpoint_state: endpoint phases are NO_WRAPPER, ATTACHED, DETACH_REQUESTED, DETACHED and PROVED_CLOSED; if detach succeeds before bookkeeping raises, retry accepts wrapper fileno minus one and continues from the recorded raw fd without a second detach or destructor reliance
V16_design_B08_poller_and_probe: pollers reference record_id, every pidfd mask passes through pidfd_ready_event, POLLNVAL is a fault and closed records are removed; close_probe is idempotent after release and requires zero local writable-kill capabilities
V16_design_B09_late_readiness: separate frozen capability identity from mutable outer-pidfd readiness; PRE_READY may become omitted before freeze, while PRE_READY_OFFER_FROZEN may become POST_OFFER_READY_RETAINED without changing offer bytes, registry identity, sequence or resend state, followed only by authenticated accepted close/omit transitions
V16_design_B10_acceptance_commit: one authoritative acceptance commit object carries frozen capability identity, late-readiness state and exhaustive receiver installed history; registry assertions admit the allowed frozen-identity readiness states and record received-then-closed rights without treating mutable readiness as byte identity
V16_design_B11_drain: use preallocated per-stream state, compute room and monotone overflow only inside each successful nonempty read iteration, break on EAGAIN or EOF without reading unbound chunk or room values, and never clear an earlier overflow observation when EOF arrives
runner_V16_authorized_resolution: create one append-only V16 runner control derived from frozen V15 and implement C01 through C07 and M01 exactly through A01-A12 and B01-B11; no assertion, label census or prose claim may substitute for the actual exception-total state transition and exhaustive identity/access logic
runner_V16_preservation_rule_1: preserve V12 OPEN-only finality, bounded positive polling, actor mark ordering, RefusalFinalityPending route, recovery resample, 80-ms finality and nonborrowable 130-ms closure tail, with all fallible nonownership checkpoints before closure starts
runner_V16_preservation_rule_2: preserve ACK-before-close, no-consume close uncertainty, nonpoison receipt, actor-loss plus drained EOF, one-send immutable offers, retained unresolved holds, carrier-before-reservation with O_EXCL, seventeen typed deltas, report-union validation, exact durability reconciliation, verified publication, one-kill monotonicity, sticky PASS and terminal durable ordering
runner_V16_preservation_rule_3: preserve the frozen V15 host, Binder V8, actor V3, derivation V6 and embedded validator identities and preserve the prospective 138-row manifest frame including immutable failed V12 history; V13 through V15 remain immutable nonmanifest failures

runner_V17_U02_resolution: prearm physical records and raw cells before every producing call, make the producing boundary itself populate the preallocated cells, and place a finally-visible cell scan around the call so every nonnegative output is adopted into the same record or retained CLOSE_RETRY even if the immediate next statement faults; cover scalar, pair, clone3, inherited and received inputs independently; define every wrapper cell and adoption phase, use nested repair that never repeats an unprotected fallible wrapper operation, and bind RLIMIT_NOFILE=256, exact high-water below 256 and CPython cached 0-through-255 scalar behavior as a required CLONE3_CPYTHON conjunct

runner_V17_U03_resolution: use one exception-total receive primitive whose protected scope starts before recvmsg and whose first no-fail return action scans the retained preallocated msghdr/control buffer into fixed raw/quarantine cells; its finally rescans all visible cells and attempts every close independently even when an earlier close remains retryable; define one concrete frame schema and five reachable callsites with exact cells 5/5/14/14/5, MSG_CMSG_CLOEXEC, truncation cleanup and nonsemantic roles through complete caller validation

runner_V17_U07_resolution: one ClosureCell is authoritative in NOT_STARTED, ACTIVE, CLOSED and RELEASED and each phase is reentrant; every fallible close, lookup, identity, poller, wrapper, journal, invariant and handoff fault is retained inside the no-return driver with positive bounded 10-to-50-ms retry; mode-specific generic, refusal or direct commit predicates are stored in the same immutable plan and used consistently from start through CLOSED and RELEASED; no process return, checkpoint, deadline, offer or state downgrade is reachable after ACTIVE

runner_V18_U02_resolution_3: pipe2/socketpair and clone3 finalizers scan the authoritative C output cells directly on every exit and independently adopt or retain every nonnegative value without an intermediate copy dependency; wrapper adoption records a protected local fallback and monotone constructor phase before the call, transfers the strong reference as the first nonfailing result action and uses nested repair that cannot repeat an unprotected fileno/detach operation
finding_U03_id: five-recv-scope-capacity-first-action-final-rescan-cleanup-and-reachability-fail
finding_U03_fact: kernel-visible msg_controllen uses CMSG_SPACE(capacity-times-int) instead of capacity times CMSG_SPACE(one-int), finalizers scan only RawCells rather than retained control bytes, prearm lies outside the protected try, cleanup can abandon CLOSE_RETRY records and the external-control wrapper has no actual caller
runner_V18_U03_resolution_1: backing storage and kernel-visible msg_controllen must both be at least installed_capacity times CMSG_SPACE(sizeof(int)); protect prearm, recvmsg, first scan and cleanup inside one scope; on every exit rescan the authoritative retained msghdr/control buffer from offset zero, capture every complete visible right and retain malformed/truncated evidence only after all rights are registered
runner_V18_U03_resolution_2: cleanup walks every frame record even if earlier close remains retryable, retains all CLOSE_RETRY records in a resumable frame-level cleanup cursor and completes that cursor before frame reuse or receive-loop continuation; EAGAIN or an original packet fault cannot mask a cleanup hold
runner_V18_U03_resolution_3: make all five wrappers reachable from final entry paths, including a concrete external-control receive call, and preserve semantic/visible capacities 4/5, 4/5, 13/14, 13/14 and 4/5 with deferred caller promotion
finding_U04_id: promotion-poller-wrapper-and-identity-transitions-are-multi-authority-or-unrepairable
finding_U04_fact: promotion swaps multiple registry mappings and scalar mirrors around one live record, poller REGISTERING state can precede record_id/fd metadata, wrapper result precedes strong record reference and watchdog physical identity omits nlink; exceptions can create duplicate slot owners, orphan REGISTERING cells or invisible identity changes
runner_V18_U04_resolution: semantic promotion changes only the one PhysicalRecord role after all validation and leaves registry lookup derived from record_id/role without a multi-mutation mapping swap; prepare poller metadata and record_id/fd first, then enter REGISTERING immediately before the external effect, with effect-unknown reconciliation discovering the cell; constructor phase/fallback is record-owned before call and exact strong reference handoff is protected; physical identity includes dev, ino, mode, nlink, uid, gid and access and is revalidated at promotion, close, census and acceptance
finding_U05_id: generic-offer-census-freeze-is-not-reentrant-before-byte-cache-install
finding_U05_fact: FREEZE advances the boundary index and leaves CENSUS_FROZEN before manifest, payload and packet reservation; a later fault cannot discard this state because discard accepts only FROZEN, so retry enters PRE_SEND without immutable offer bytes
runner_V18_U05_resolution: make census preparation CENSUS_PREPARED nonauthoritative and do all manifest/payload/reservation work before the atomic transition that installs exact immutable bytes, digest, record-id sets, epoch, sequence and state FROZEN; boundary index advances only in that same assignment; any preassignment fault resets the prepared census without consuming sequence, while every postassignment fault retains one-send FROZEN state and resumes only PRE_SEND/acceptance
finding_U06_id: receiver-proof-late-readiness-and-acceptance-commit-are-unauthenticated-or-nonatomic
finding_U06_fact: accepted receipt keys omit receiver installed history/current-live/kill census and received-then-closed disposition; V17 fabricates them from watchdog-local receive history, does not poll the offered outer pidfd, leaves a readiness race, strands PREPARING and advances EXTERNAL_RECV_SEQ before the acceptance object becomes COMMITTED

runner_V18_U06_resolution_3: prepare one complete immutable candidate off to the side without mutating shared state; validate sequence, predecessor, receiver proof, identity/access, census, kill, deadline, cache and readiness completely, then atomically assign one COMMITTED object from which EXTERNAL_RECV_SEQ and all generic/refusal mirrors are derived; PREPARING is never authoritative and no fallible mutation follows the commit assignment before entering closure

finding_E01_id: proved-probe-turnover-authority-is-not-idempotent-before-next-arm
finding_E01_fact: successful close_probe stores last proved turnover and increments completed count but leaves the old turnover authority live; a repeated close_probe before the next pidfd_arm reuses the old ordinal, requires completed count still equal it, and enters permanent caught retry because completed is already ordinal plus one
runner_V23_E01_resolution_1: successful turnover commits a distinct PROVED_RETURNABLE state containing ordinal, exact causal tuple, snapshot reset and exhaustive closure proof, retires the in-progress turnover authority, and permits any repeated close_probe before the next arm to verify the same proof and return idempotently without recount, mutation, close or retry
runner_V23_E01_resolution_2: the next pidfd_arm alone consumes PROVED_RETURNABLE after matching its five-field causal tuple and expected completed ordinal, then installs one fresh turnover authority for the new probe; no failure can clear proved state early or advance completed count twice, and all fifteen probe plus arbitrary repeated-close induction is explicit
finding_E02_id: deterministic-wrapper-mismatch-records-exist-but-base-state-and-frozen-plan-prevent-closure
finding_E02_fact: a different wrapper return is stored in a dedicated transient record, but the base enters a stable terminal whose final repair always raises; before plan freeze the cursor stalls on the base, while a mismatch discovered during base closure after freeze is absent from the immutable plan and the later transient sweep is unreachable because the base cursor never advances
runner_V23_E02_resolution_1: replace stable raise terminals with an explicit MISMATCH_DRAIN_PENDING state; close-one returns a nonthrowing NEED_TRANSIENT_DRAIN outcome, the driver immediately drains every newly live bound mismatch record through identity-safe ordinary closure before retrying the same base cursor, and actor_close_all uses the same fixed-point base-plus-transient work loop
runner_V23_E02_resolution_2: after all mismatch records are proved closed, reobserve the strongly retained base wrapper through its next fixed observation cell and either prove DETACHED, authorize its remaining bounded detach attempt, or retain one explicit finite terminal without losing census authority; no completed transient can resurrect and no base error is rethrown before available reconciliation work runs
runner_V23_E02_resolution_3: immutable plan membership covers records live at freeze, while a mandatory per-cursor side-drain covers records discovered during close; CLOSED and RELEASED require zero live base and transient records, all result cells DISARMED and every mismatch identity reconciled, so before-freeze and after-freeze discoveries share one exhaustive proof

finding_G01_id: partial-probe-arming-and-nonprobe-closure-use-competing-authorities-and-final-close-probe-misroutes-released-state
finding_G01_fact: main preinstalls ARMING, but refresh, deadline, stream or captured-base exceptions can enter the independent nonprobe ClosureCell without atomically consuming the probe authority; after owner release main unconditionally calls a final close_probe that now requires probe authority, so pre-probe refusal/terminal paths reject None and partial ARMING can coexist with or outlive completed nonprobe closure
runner_V25_G01_resolution_1: introduce one top-level owner-authority discriminator with mutually exclusive NONE, PROBE_ARMING, PROBE_ARMED, PROBE_PROVED and OWNER_CLOSURE states; every terminal/nonprobe takeover atomically converts the current partial or full probe authority into the one ClosureCell plan, transfers every currently live probe record and reconciliation obligation, retires probe ownership and then tail-enters the no-return closure driver
runner_V25_G01_resolution_2: wrap refresh, deadline, stream_arm, captured-base pidfd_arm and all fallible per-probe work inside the preinstalled probe authority catch-all; handled probe failure either remains under probe close/retry or executes the single takeover transition before propagation, with no interval containing zero or two authorities
runner_V25_G01_resolution_3: final close_probe dispatches OWNER_CLOSURE ACTIVE/CLOSED to the nonprobe driver, treats RELEASED as an exhaustive idempotent no-op, handles PROBE_ARMING/ARMED through probe close, handles PROBE_PROVED by proof recheck, and permits NONE only when an exhaustive census proves no probe records ever became live; owner_released never routes into a probe-only assertion

finding_L01_id: active-control-and-review-routing-remains-V28-and-current-owner-symbol-is-undefined
finding_L01_fact: active Sections 16 and 17 still instruct launcher, prebind, formal, manifest and intrinsic routing for final V28/E0393, while final prose claims WATCHDOG_V29_OWNER_AUTHORITY although no such symbol exists and the actual current tuple retains WATCHDOG_V28_OWNER_AUTHORITY; V29 therefore has no self-consistent current review or owner binding
finding_L02_id: receipt-ahead-publication-and-same-epoch-reentry-do-not-form-a-total-acquisition-state-machine
finding_L02_fact_1: target authority may publish at epoch e+1 before record epoch advances; scalar caller has not received its local record, inherited finally cannot capture it, and closure finalization rejects the receipt-record epoch mismatch instead of resuming or rolling back the embedded prior authority
finding_L02_fact_2: matching acquisition logic treats close-prepared, close-pending, effect-observed and normalized receipt phases as acquisition-active and returns ACQUIRING, OWNED or CLOSE_RETRY records to scalar producers that unconditionally repeat OPENAT, DUP or MEMFD effects
finding_L02_fact_3: transient resume may advance the record to ACQUIRING before publishing reconciliation and wrapper authority, yet retry first requires CLOSED; neither acquisition nor closure can resume this middle state
finding_L03_id: receive-right-authority-is-not-a-total-installed-census-or-cleanup-source
finding_L03_fact: a receive right may have CLOSE_OBSERVATION_PREPARED with its raw number while record.raw_fd remains minus one, but inherited cleanup scans only live records and reset rejects that receipt phase; if identity later fails transiently, installed_count is not incremented, so even a subsequently typed and closed installed right is classified as not-installed never-live and frame proof rejects it
finding_L04_id: reconciliation-close-preparation-may-terminalize-before-reconciliation-PREPARED
finding_L04_fact: reconciliation bound construction calls the close-receipt preparer before publishing the reconciliation cell; its preidentity EBADF branch may publish close effect and terminalize the record, producing the exact forbidden close-then-PREPARED ordering in the positive source
finding_L05_id: expected-alias-retirement-and-alias-refinement-are-not-total
finding_L05_fact_1: the live inherited expected-alias retire caller reaches V29 clear with CLOSE_PREPARED, but V29 clear has no alias-retired effect branch and instead requires CLOSED_BOUND, so ordinary fileno, detach and fallback alias retirement fail without injected interruption
finding_L05_fact_2: alias state publishes before mutable provenance is refined with owner id and identity; interruption exposes an alias whose later close reads provenance minus two as owner id but obtains the kind bytes, while no immutable alias refinement authority contains the missing fields
finding_L06_id: pre-receipt-EBADF-negative-removes-both-prearm-and-observation
finding_L06_fact: the PRE_RECEIPT_EBADF recipe substitutes a receipt lookup for prearm, after which identity-under-authority detects the wrong phase and skips observation; the mutant models omitted prearm plus omitted EBADF rather than identity observation before receipt authority
runner_V30_required_transition_A: define one authoritative acquisition operation cell per record whose immutable tuple includes request, prior completed receipt, target epoch, caller kind, effect state and all derived frame/reconciliation metadata; one pointer publication precedes effects, and every caller plus closure can find the cell globally without relying on a local return value
runner_V30_required_transition_B: separate PREPARED_NO_EFFECT, EFFECT_IN_PROGRESS, RESULT_CAPTURED, RECORD_ADOPTED, CLOSE_PREPARED, CLOSE_EFFECT_OBSERVED, NORMALIZED and TERMINAL; producer retry may execute an effect only from PREPARED_NO_EFFECT, while any later phase resumes capture, adoption, close or finalization and never replays the producer syscall
runner_V30_required_transition_C: provide a global ahead-by-one reconciler that consumes the authoritative cell before generic closed-receipt validation; it either completes record adoption from a captured result, or, when no effect began, publishes a typed never-live target-epoch terminal while preserving and validating the prior completed authority
runner_V30_required_transition_D: publish per-index installed-right authority from the recv result before fallible identity or record-field projection; derive and repair installed_count and frame installed bits from those cells, and make cleanup scan their raw numbers even when record.raw_fd is minus one
runner_V30_required_transition_E: publish reconciliation PREPARED directly from existing immutable acquisition/installed authority before invoking any close preparer or identity observation; a preidentity form is valid and later refines within that one reconciliation authority
runner_V30_required_transition_F: publish one immutable alias refinement cell containing record id, base owner id, epoch, kind, raw, identity/access and provenance before the semantic alias state; normal expected-alias clear recognizes CLOSE_PREPARED and publishes ALIAS_RETIRED_NO_PHYSICAL_CLOSE before idempotent normalization, and mismatch logic never infers owner id from mutable provenance positions
runner_V30_required_transition_G: make active Sections 16/17, launcher/prebind/formal/manifest route, current callable graph, final binding and one actually defined WATCHDOG_V30_OWNER_AUTHORITY name exact V30/E0396 after the later advisory-consumption event; all V29 and earlier routes become immutable HISTORICAL_NONCALLABLE

finding_S01_fact: v30_validate_current_watchdog_surface obtains retired_begin from the first generic WATCHDOG_V29_LIVE_CALLABLE_GRAPH assignment at watchdog offset 786118 rather than the later historical-noncallable retirement at offset 946445; with V30 graph at 931896 and binding at 944447, its required graph-before-binding-before-retirement ordering is unconditionally false

finding_S03_id: actual-actor-and-watchdog-entrypoints-still-extract-V27-delimiters
finding_S03_fact: actor main and watchdog static_inputs extract physical V27 actor and watchdog boundary lines from the supplied current plan, while the V30 artifact physically contains the unique V30 boundaries and no physical V27 source boundary lines; both actual launch paths reject the exact V30 source despite the declarative V30 current binding
finding_S04_id: same-serial-wrapper-fileno-can-be-replayed
finding_S04_fact: the first wrapper fileno return exists only in a local variable before result-bank publication; EFFECT_IN_PROGRESS recovery with an armed sentinel calls wrapper.fileno again under the same operation serial, and bind_lifecycle_endpoint also retains a direct current fileno call outside operation authority and the caller audit
finding_S05_id: stale-route-negative-does-not-cover-the-actual-stale-runtime-route
finding_S05_fact: STALE_V29_CURRENT_ROUTE mutates only the declarative V30 current-binding tuple to V29, while the actual actor and watchdog extraction callsites are already stale V27; the recipe cannot establish rejection of the real current-route defect
finding_L01_id: frame-association-and-frame-row-use-incompatible-installed-authority-shapes
finding_L01_fact: v30_frame_association returns the raw six-field installed authority, v30_frame_row stores the expanded frame-ordinal-and-index plus authority eight-tuple, and v30_validate_frame_row requires those values equal; every nonempty frame proof is therefore unsatisfiable
finding_L02_id: immutable-input-prepared-result-publication-gap-can-erase-an-existing-live-right
finding_L02_fact: lifecycle_adopt_raw publishes PREPARED_NO_EFFECT before publishing the known inherited raw number as RESULT_CAPTURED; global reconciliation treats that nonreceive PREPARED state as proved never-live, so an interruption can clear a physically live inherited descriptor from registry and closure census
finding_L03_id: installed-right-authority-is-not-exhaustive-over-the-actual-control-buffer
finding_L03_fact: the inherited ancillary buffer can hold more SCM_RIGHTS integers than installed_capacity, but V30 allocates only installed_capacity installed cells; overflow scan sets RIGHTS_OVERFLOW without binding or closing the extra kernel-installed descriptors, so full-capacity cleanup is not exhaustive
finding_L04_id: terminal-frame-bank-and-reconciliation-projection-gaps-have-no-reentry-repair
finding_L04_fact_1: frame producer TERMINAL publishes before the frame result bank becomes CONSUMED; terminal reentry repairs frame mirrors but not the bank, so an interruption can leave RESULT_STORED and block the next frame epoch
finding_L04_fact_2: reconciliation TERMINAL publishes before compatibility projection; closed-record and resume loops repair only PREPARED, so interruption leaves a permanently stale reconciliation projection and failed terminal proof
finding_L05_id: promotion-role-commit-to-frame-promoted-gap-is-not-globally-repaired
finding_L05_fact: semantic role and ROLE_COMMITTED publish before frame.mark_promoted and promotion COMMITTED; closure and inherited finalization permit but do not complete this state, so interruption at a promotion cut can make committed-prefix, outer-capture and terminal frame history unconstructible
finding_L06_id: owner-closure-positive-wait-and-no-return-chain-can-spin-or-escape
finding_L06_fact_1: v30_owner_state_loop invokes the possibly pending global reconciler before its retry wait; repeated pending therefore loops without reaching positive_wait
finding_L06_fact_2: takeover, probe-exception, closure-installer and close-probe entrypoints call global reconciliation outside the inherited retry/no-return driver; a pending operation can escape before owner publication and reach the generic SystemExit path without owner release

finding_S01_id: actor-complete-scan-no-right-terminal-is-not-next-epoch-rearmable
finding_S01_fact: actor prearm requires every quarantine record CLOSED before setting the five cells ACQUIRING/raw minus one, but the complete scan terminalizes PREPARED_NO_RIGHT as NOT_INSTALLED_TERMINAL without actor_record_reset_closed_v19 or raw-cell disarm and cleanup skips a row whose raw binding is None while still publishing FULL_CAPACITY_CLOSED; a later zero-right receive therefore fails the prearm CLOSED invariant and its terminal proof is false
finding_S02_id: eight-live-actor-route-overrides-escape-the-canonical-assignment-census-and-one-signature-is-incompatible
finding_S02_fact: the actual actor route overrides v19_validate_raw_contract, actor_recvmsg_primitive_v19, actor_recvmsg_site_v19, actor_receive_scan_v19, actor_receive_rescan_v19, actor_receive_cleanup_v19, extract_one and main occur outside 32V1AS01 and their exact actor lhs/rhs pairs are absent from the 148-row assignment and rebind census; the six actor-specific lhs also lack rebind roots, nodes and edges, while shared extract_one and main rows describe only watchdog pairs; additionally the inherited one-argument actor_receive_rescan_v19(frame) is rebound to actor_v32_scan_frame(frame,count), which requires two arguments
finding_S03_id: inherited-watch-recvmsg-primitive-entry-is-rebound-to-a-six-argument-driver
finding_S03_fact: the live five-argument watch_recvmsg_primitive_v19(control,context,frame,received_slots,quarantine_slots) compatibility root is rebound to v32_receive_driver, whose sixth required effect argument is supplied only by newer site wrappers; the advertised inherited EXTERNAL_ENTRY therefore fails its retained call contract even though nominal graph rows exist
finding_L01_id: reconciliation-terminal-compatibility-repair-is-an-infinite-rebind-cycle
finding_L01_fact: v32_repair_reconciliation_compatibility calls v28_project_reconciliation_compatibility for TERMINAL, v32_project_reconciliation_compatibility calls back into the repair, and physical rebinding installs the latter under the former name; every terminal repair recurses without a base case, so reconciliation, K03 and owner release cannot close
finding_L02_id: transient-reconciliation-return-contract-is-broken
finding_L02_fact: v32_reconcile_transient returns the Boolean close outcome, while the retained live mismatch drain requires V23_MISMATCH_DRAINED or V23_SAFE_HOLD_POSITIVE_WAIT; the installed compatibility rebind therefore treats successful terminal reconciliation as pending and can block F02 and release forever
finding_L03_id: owner-closure-retry-wrappers-can-leak-aggregate-pending-from-except-suites
finding_L03_fact: all six V32 retry wrappers invoke positive wait and after-wait reconciliation directly inside an except BaseException suite; OwnershipClosePending raised by that reconciliation is not caught by the same try and escapes instead of reentering the loop, violating no-return OWNER_CLOSURE containment despite the textual wait-before-reconcile order
finding_L04_id: scalar-wrapper-and-frame-pre-effect-orphans-are-not-exactly-resumable
finding_L04_fact: scalar and wrapper matching TERMINAL/no-effect operations are classified active and later dereference absent results or commit empty banks, while an exact frame reentry at PRODUCER_PUBLISHED_NO_EFFECT generically terminalizes and consumes the producer then returns a no-effect frame without recvmsg; matching retry neither adopts the prebuilt pointer nor safely reserves a new attributable attempt
finding_L05_id: frame-ticket-does-not-bind-the-exact-effect-producer
finding_L05_fact: v32_frame_prearm publishes only the generic v32_frame_effect_producer pointer and its request omits the effect callable, while v32_receive_driver later supplies a separate monitored, external-control, external-receipt or refusal effect; the ticket cannot prove exact producer identity or matching retry lineage
finding_L06_id: promotion-recovery-requires-an-unpublished-outer-mirror-and-misrepairs-terminal-suffixes
finding_L06_fact: the live promotion cut publishes capture and PREPARED before the outer owner capture, but V32 recovery requires that outer mirror rather than repairing it; it also converts unrecognized terminals including CLOSE_ATTEMPT_LIVE_RETRY to OWNED, omits closed-context and old-slot terminal repair, and therefore cannot drive PREPARED, ROLE_COMMITTED or COMMITTED through the complete required suffix
finding_L07_id: endpoint-takeover-leaves-a-stale-published-context-wrapper
finding_L07_fact: an interruption after context endpoint publication and before NORMAL_BOUND_CONSUMED can be taken over and terminalized as TAKEOVER_SUBSUMED after quarantine and raw close, but takeover never removes or terminalizes context[endpoint_key] and owner proof does not check it; release may expose a quarantined wrapper whose raw descriptor is closed
finding_L08_id: global-progress-snapshot-omits-mutable-authority-projections

finding_S01_id: ticket-result-suite-has-an-unexpected-indent
finding_S01_fact: v33_ticket_result begins its function suite at lines 92220 through 92223 with one-space indentation, but expected assignment at lines 92224 through 92226 increases to two spaces without any suite opener; the extracted current watchdog source is not constructible
finding_S02_id: terminal-ticket-proof-dedents-out-of-loop-then-reindents-without-opener
finding_S02_fact: v33_terminal_ticket_proof starts its per-cell loop at lines 93687 through 93690, dedents expected at 93691 and then reindents checks at 93694 onward without an intervening suite opener; the intended per-ticket checks are outside the loop and the current source is not constructible
finding_S03_id: retained-acquisition-and-static-input-call-contracts-are-bidirectionally-incompatible
finding_S03_fact: retained acquire_external_owner(context) at line70334 is rebound to v33_acquire_external_owner(context,control), which passes two arguments to one-argument v32_acquire_external_owner; retained static_inputs(context) at line70449 is rebound to zero-argument v33_static_inputs, which calls one-argument v32_static_inputs with no context; both physical current entries reject their real callers and miscall their frozen bases
finding_S04_id: legacy-callback-adapter-rejects-real-v31-closures-and-declares-nonexistent-dispatch-edges
finding_S04_fact: retained V31 passes local two-argument effect(bank,frame) closures, but v33_v31_receive_driver_adapter requires object identity with four different v33_legacy_effect wrappers and never calls the supplied legacy_effect; the four declared CALLBACK_DISPATCH edges to those wrappers have no corresponding bounded-source calls and the external callback parameter is not truthfully connected
finding_L01_id: actor-terminal-receipt-is-published-before-enclosing-packet-acceptance
finding_L01_fact: v33_parse_packet decodes and v33_accept_actor_terminal_receipt mutates the global receipt cell before V33_PARSE_PACKET_BASE authenticates and sequence-checks the enclosing packet; later rejection has no rollback, so K03 and terminal proof can consume a receipt from a rejected packet
finding_L02_id: shared-scalar-wrapper-bank-can-be-certified-against-a-stale-sibling-ticket-serial
finding_L02_fact: scalar and wrapper tickets share one mutable result bank, but V33 terminal reconciliation has no V32-equivalent sibling projection follower and ticket finish/result/terminal proof do not require bank serial to equal ticket serial; a terminal sibling at N-minus-one can observe and certify the bank at N
finding_L03_id: promotion-exact-closed-partition-omits-four-inherited-terminal-dispositions
finding_L03_fact: inherited terminal repair recognizes PROVED_NEVER_LIVE, PRODUCER_ERROR_NO_RIGHT, PREIDENTITY_EBADF_PROVED_CLOSED, PHYSICAL_CLOSE_PROVED, ALIAS_RETIRED_NO_PHYSICAL_CLOSE and WRAPPER_OBSERVATION_UNKNOWN_NO_REPLAY as closed, while V33 promotion recovery and proof accept only the middle physical-close and preidentity-EBADF pair; the other exact-closed leaves are coerced toward owned or stranded pending
finding_L04_id: closure-image-is-frozen-before-owner-publication-that-it-must-later-equal
finding_L04_fact: v33_current_owner_plan freezes a progress image containing prior owner state before the inherited owner loop publishes OWNER_CLOSURE, but terminal proof later requires a recomputed postpublication image to equal the frozen one; the owner-plan cell itself is also absent from progress dimensions, so real closure publication makes equality impossible and is not fully observed
finding_L05_id: inherited-successful-owner-release-return-is-converted-to-permanent-pending
finding_L05_fact: V33_OWNER_RELEASE_BASE ultimately returns True on success, but v33_owner_release_exhaustive accepts only an exception singleton and converts every normal return to OwnershipClosePending; its RELEASED publication, terminal proof and exact singleton raise are therefore unreachable on the actual inherited contract
finding_L06_id: ticket-source-layout-defects-also-break-lifecycle-proof
finding_L06_fact: the malformed v33_ticket_result and v33_terminal_ticket_proof suite indentation independently prevents the ticket result and terminal proof lifecycle from representing their intended control flow
finding_L07_id: retained-entry-abi-defects-make-lifecycle-route-nonenterable
finding_L07_fact: the acquire_external_owner and static_inputs incompatibilities occur on retained main and input paths before the V33 lifecycle can reach its otherwise present ticket, promotion, endpoint or closure machinery
